scope: Independent execution against frozen source; no source, product, test, config, Git, environment or credential mutations. Only this report directory written.

findings.title: Action input exceeds declared latest-three outcome capacity from decision five
findings.expected: Every actually delivered action input exposes at most the latest three distinct admitted inquiry outcome records.
findings.actual: After six normal delivered decisions, step5 retains o2,o3,o4 in inquiryOutcomeContext.inquiryOutcomeMemory and o3,o4,o5 in inquiryOutcomeMemory. Union is four records; step6 likewise four. The script captures evaluate arguments, not only persisted sidecars. Baseline replay accepts the run.
findings.cause: The assessment before-context remains on wire when the updated action memory is added. Independent module memory capacity3 checks do not catch the union.

findings.title: Replay accepts undeclared inquiry outcome questions in action stage, including disabled mode and native failure
findings.expected: Reject outcome questions outside the configured assessment stage, including unconfigured and early-failure artifacts, even after legitimate outer hashes are recomputed.
findings.actual: An added action-stage questions.inquiryOutcome_result with copied valid choice definition and recomputed inputSha256 is accepted by replay. Reproduced on configured normal second step, old experience-working-inquiry first step, and first-step native HTTP failure. The original raw artifacts remain preserved.
findings.cause: outcomePresent and expected outcome question checks inspect deliberation.questions, but not step.questions. Thus injected action-only outcome questions evade stage and configuration guards.
